english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that food tastes delicious.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for food that has a pleasant or satisfying flavor.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for saying that food is delicious.
Use this as the everyday choice for food that tastes good.
Use this specifically when food tastes good or is delicious.
